repos_data.description: View disk space usage and delete unwanted data, fast.
Safety-first disk cleaner and space analyzer for macOS, Windows and Linux, with duplicate cleanup, app uninstall, startup management, system optimization, and maintenance.

Free, open-source disk usage analyzer for macOS, Windows and Linux. See what fills your disk, servers (SSH) and cloud storage in an animated sunburst or treemap, and clean it up safely. A DaisyDisk, WizTree and WinDirStat alternative, in native Rust 🦀
Strata Files: a fast, native, keyboard-first file manager and Finder alternative for macOS. Instant search, live folder sizes, disk usage map, dual pane.

Free, open-source disk space analyzer for macOS, inspired by WinDirStat. See what's taking up space on your Mac with an interactive treemap and track down large files. Native SwiftUI app for Apple silicon and Intel, signed and notarized, fully offline.
Free, open-source Mac cleaner. Clear junk, uninstall apps completely, and see what's using your disk.
